name: message_id
description: pubsub message id, unique per delivery not per event

name: event_id
description: business key lifted out of the payload so staging can dedupe on it

name: schema_version
description: contract version the producer claimed to be emitting

name: ingest_ts
description: when the subscriber wrote this row, used for partitioning

name: payload
description: the event exactly as received, never edited
